_readme: Publication surface of the job tree. A company publishes by getting an entry into this file (see docs/jobs-tree.md); the merge IS the publication. Seed entries use reserved .example domains on purpose — replace them with real postings, never point a leaf at a URL nobody curated. Contract enforced by src/locales/jobs-data.test.mjs.
